stories.title: Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Pakistan and Turkiye condemn Houthi attacks on Kingdom

en.title: Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Pakistan and Turkiye condemn Houthi attacks on Kingdom
en.summary: Four countries' foreign ministers issued a joint statement condemning attacks on Saudi Arabia, including recent Houthi strikes, and reaffirmed support for its sovereignty and right to self-defense during UN General Assembly meetings in New York.

stories.title: Trump promises peace deal with Iran post midterms in UNGA address

en.title: Trump promises peace deal with Iran post midterms in UNGA address
en.summary: US President Trump told the UN General Assembly that his administration aims to reach a peace deal with Iran after the November midterm elections, while warning of potential military action and calling for economic isolation of Iran.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Pakistan, Türkiye condemn attacks on Kingdom, back right to self-defense

en.title: Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Pakistan, Türkiye condemn attacks on Kingdom, back right to self-defense
en.summary: Foreign ministers from four nations condemned all attacks on Saudi Arabia, including recent Houthi strikes, and reaffirmed support for the Kingdom's sovereignty and legal right to defend itself during UN General Assembly consultations.

stories.title: Trump in Address to World Leaders at UN Defends His Decision to Start War Against Iran

en.title: Trump in Address to World Leaders at UN Defends His Decision to Start War Against Iran
en.summary: US President Trump defended his decision to initiate military conflict with Iran during his address to world leaders at the United Nations.

stories.title: King Salman condemns Houthi 'terrorist militia' attempts to target Makkah

en.title: King Salman condemns Houthi 'terrorist militia' attempts to target Makkah
en.summary: King Salman condemned Houthi militia attempts to target Makkah, stating the attack provoked Muslim sentiment worldwide and violated the sanctity of holy sites. He praised military and security personnel for defending the Kingdom.

stories.title: King Salman: Houthi bid to target Makkah provokes sentiments of world Muslims

en.title: King Salman: Houthi bid to target Makkah provokes sentiments of world Muslims
en.summary: King Salman condemned repeated Houthi militia attempts to target Makkah as a crime violating the sanctity of holy sites that provokes Muslims worldwide. He praised God for blessings on the country and the honor of serving the Grand Mosque.

stories.title: Saudi King Hails Forces Defending Kingdom, Condemns Houthi Attempts to Target Makkah

en.title: Saudi King Hails Forces Defending Kingdom, Condemns Houthi Attempts to Target Makkah
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's King commended military and security forces for defending the Kingdom and condemned Houthi attempts to target Makkah.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia resumes East-West Pipeline operations: Report

en.title: Saudi Arabia resumes East-West Pipeline operations: Report
en.summary: Saudi Arabia has begun restarting its East-West Pipeline, a crucial route for transporting crude oil to the Red Sea port of Yanbu for export without transiting the Strait of Hormuz. Operations are resuming at reduced flow rates.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia leads Middle East private-capital fundraising, BlackRock says

en.title: Saudi Arabia leads Middle East private-capital fundraising, BlackRock says
en.summary: Saudi Arabia accounted for approximately 61 percent of private-capital funds closed in the Middle East since 2015, with 359 of 590 regional funds based there, more than double the UAE's 143 funds, according to BlackRock analysis.

stories.title: Sources: Saudi Arabia Restarts East-West Oil Pipeline

en.title: Sources: Saudi Arabia Restarts East-West Oil Pipeline
en.summary: Saudi Arabia has restarted its East-West Oil Pipeline following earlier disruptions.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia restarts East-West oil pipeline, to resume exports from Yanbu, sources say

en.title: Saudi Arabia restarts East-West oil pipeline, to resume exports from Yanbu, sources say
en.summary: Saudi Arabia has restarted its East-West Pipeline after drone attacks forced it to shut on September 13, with operations resuming at a low rate and exports expected to resume from the Yanbu port.

stories.title: UN condemns continued Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, urges restraint

en.title: UN condemns continued Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, urges restraint
en.summary: The United Nations condemned ongoing Houthi cross-border attacks against Saudi Arabia, including attempted strikes on Riyadh and attacks on civilians and energy infrastructure, and called for restraint from all parties.

stories.title: ‎King Salman condemns Houthi militia’s repeated attempt to target Makkah

en.title: King Salman condemns Houthi militia's repeated attempt to target Makkah
en.summary: King Salman condemned the Houthi militia's repeated attempts to target Makkah during a Cabinet session, calling the actions a heinous crime that violates holy site sanctity and provokes Muslim sentiment worldwide.

stories.title: ‎SVCP shareholders to vote on 69.71% capital cut on Oct. 22

en.title: SVCP shareholders to vote on 69.71% capital cut on Oct. 22
en.summary: Saudi Vitrified Clay Pipes Co. will hold a shareholder vote on October 22 to reduce capital by 69.71%, from SAR 150 million to SAR 45.43 million, to offset accumulated losses of SAR 104.57 million.

stories.title: ‎Rawasi Albina files lawsuits against former CEO, Chairman

en.title: Rawasi Albina files lawsuits against former CEO, Chairman
en.summary: Rawasi Albina Investment Co. has filed a lawsuit against former Managing Director and CEO Meteb Alotaibi and Chairman Abdullah Alotaibi, seeking precautionary attachment on properties mortgaged to the company during a review of the former director's tenure.

en.title: Naseej's rump offering covered 311.8%
en.summary: Naseej International Trading Co. completed a rump offering with 311.8% subscription coverage, selling 2.96 million shares at an average price of SAR 12.28 per share and generating SAR 36.44 million in proceeds.

stories.title: ‎CMA seeks public input on IPOs enhancement controls

en.title: CMA seeks public input on IPOs enhancement controls
en.summary: The Capital Market Authority invited market participants to provide feedback on proposed regulatory provisions to strengthen initial public offering practices, with a 30-day consultation period ending October 22.
